text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One got injured during training,
so I rushed her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Sorry, I botched it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Say no more.
You're gonna tell me to take a break for a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's just not in my nature
to sit around doing nothing.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I can put up with a little pain.
So could ya just turn a blind eye
while I do some special training?
choice_data_list: You really need to get some proper rest.
Let's look for something we can do together.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I figured you'd say that, Boss...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I figured Big Sis would say something like that...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' I can do about it. I'll just treat it as patience training
and stay still until my injury heals up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I ain't tacky enough
to go practicing behind your back."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One said so disappointedly and headed back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. So you're not gonna let me shoulder
all the responsibility on my own, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hearin' you say that, Boss,
nothin' could be more reassurin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hearing you say that, Big Sis,
nothing could be more reassuring!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's resume training right away!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I only did some light exercises, but the pain is unbearable...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Boss... Looks like I'd better
not make any reckless moves for a while...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Sis... Looks like I'd better
not make any reckless moves for a while...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One immediately halted her training to focus entirely on treating her injury...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "One-two! Three-four!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Even with the injury,
light calisthenics seem to be totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If I keep this up, my body won't get rusty.
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One trained sensibly within a safe range while being mindful of her injury.
